answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can earn or vote; the bond stays locked for a full epoch and is slashed if the identity double-signs or spams. A gale of fake accounts then costs real capital per account, so spinning up thousands stops paying. Honest agents climb toward the summit of a reputation ladder only through sustained, verifiable work, and the canyon between a fresh account and a trusted one — time, bond, and history — makes mass forgery uneconomical while keeping entry open for one genuine newcomer.
